tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dpe tho bzhugs so//

༄༅// rje btsun sprul longs chos tshul ke tu'i tog /mdo rgyud rtogs pa lha mi klu'i gces thag /yid bzhin nor bu gsum gdams ngag bzhin du// 'dod don grub pa'i dgongs ldan ngal gsos dge /der phab rin chen blun tshig na ku le'i/ khong par 'byams pas bzhed don gegs gzigs nas// byin brlabs phyag gis mgrin btsir ma god par// skyugs 'di tho yig gzhong par gzed phyir btung*// 'dir mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu rnam pa gsum par grags pa la/ brgyud pa yid gzhin gyi nor bur 'brel ba phyag rgya chen po gaṅga ma/ gnad kyi man ngag zer/ bsam mi khyab kyi do ha brgyad/ de'i bsgom rim zab mo brgyad tillis/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar ni mang bas ma bkod/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ de'i 'grel pa gzhung chung*/ dbang mdud dgrol/ chos nyid gnyug ma'i mgur gsum tilli pas/ smin lam dbang gi tho yig nā ro pas/ smin lam chen mo tshan gnyis snga rabs pa mar pa'i gsung du 'dod de zhang lo'i zin bris/ yab 'grel rgyal po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs mngal skyes sbyong ba'i bskyed rim yin pas rgyas pa nā ros/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sgong skyes sbyong byed 'bring po rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ de gnyis la 'kho ba la pradzñā rakshī tas chos gsum mi zab pa'i bskyed rim/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu nā ros/ 'di ngam rdzong snyan brgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ de'i mngon rtogs bsgom rim mar pas/ bdag byin rlob kyi gzhung sgrub thabs rdzus skyes sbyong byed yin pas bsdus pa ste phyi ma gnyis zab pa'i bskyed rim/ blon po rigs gsum las byed dang*/ dmangs kyi rnal 'byor bdun mar pas/ yum 'grel rgyal mo chos nyid mi 'gyur ba la/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs lha mo bco lnga'i gzhung mkha' 'gro mas/

lha bdun ma nā ros/ lhan cig skyes ma'i rtsa ba rje btsun nā ro pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ 'di'i thun mong nor bu skor gsum khyung tshang pas/ bsre ba'i yig tshan gsum mar pas/ bdud rtsi ril sgrub nā ros/ dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu bsdus pa mar pas/ rgyas pa khyung tshang pas/ grol lam steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i chos drug rje btsun gyis mdzad par grags pa/ sems kyi skyon sel mi ldog pa'i gzer gsum khyung tshang pas 'di sgyu lus rmi lam gyi zhal gdam yin/ bsam mi khyab don bzhi ma rje btsun gyis mdzad pa 'od gsal gyi zhal gdam yin/ 'chi ltas gnyis/ 'chi bslu gnyis/ 'og sgo bde chen la rje btsun ras chung pas tho yig /brtag pa 'od rig bde chen/ 'og sgo mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gsum zhang los/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed/ bar do blo chod zhal gdams/ bya spyod tshogs bsgyur gsum rje btsun gyi gsung du grags pa/ zhal gdams nor bu'i phra bkod zhang los mdzad pa/ 'khrul 'khor gsal ba'i me long mar pas/ lam spyi'i gegs sel khyung tshang pas/ rtsa rlung gi gegs sel khyung tshang pas/ bdud brtag pa dang*/ bdud lam khyer gnyis rje btsun/ ga dar gyi don bsdu rje btsun gyis/ yum bka' las 'phros pa/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos sde lnga mar pas spyan drangs/ de'i rnam bshad mdzad pa/ sba bzhi ras chungs pas spyan drangs/ rnam bshad de'i gsung la ngam rdzong pa'i zin bris/ bde chen gsung gi rin chen gyi bsnyen pa bsgrub pa zhal gdams sbyor chos dang bcas pa/ ro snyoms gsum/ khams kyi rab dbye rdorje mkha' 'gro'i rgyas 'grel las phyung ba/ tilli'i gtad rgya/ mi la'i gtad rgya/ mgon po'i gzhung kam pa las mdzad pa/ las tshogs ras chung pas mdzad pa'o// 'di rnams yig rnying gces pa yin pas phyin chad 'di ltar du bris shig/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
